meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构查找并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常常要成批改动代码或统一代码风格。
copy.tagline_en: Find code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely refactor code patterns across many files.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按代码结构(而非纯文本)搜索和重写代码:找出特定形状的代码(如函数、调用、类),批量重写(如 `console.log` 改为 `logger.info`),先预览再应用,并支持运行 YAML 规则。
howto.when: 当用户要求按代码结构查找、重写或批量修改代码时触发,例如找出特定形状的函数/调用/类、把 `console.log` 改成 `logger.info`、移除 `as any` 等。若目标是文本内容或文件名,则改用 grep/rg。

say.text: 找出所有接受 Request 参数的函数。
say.note: 会按结构搜索并列出匹配的文件与行号。

say.text: 把全仓库的 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x)。
say.note: 会先显示预览,确认后才实际改动。

say.text: 找出所有空的 catch 块并列出文件位置。
say.note: 会运行搜索并汇总受影响文件数。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can search and rewrite code based on code structure (AST) rather than plain text. It finds structural matches (functions, calls, classes, imports), rewrites patterns (e.g., console.log to logger.info), dry-runs first, and can run YAML rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to find or rewrite code by structure (e.g., find functions shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip as any, run YAML rules). Use grep/rg for text or file names.

say_en.text: Find all functions that take a Request parameter.
say_en.note: Claude searches structurally and lists matches.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x) repo-wide.
Find all empty catch blocks and list their locations.
say_en.note: Claude runs a search and summarizes affected files.
